title: Pessimistic Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It proposes and evaluates a methodology called 'pessimistic evaluation' for information access systems based on worst-case utility, as an alternative to average utility.
findings: The paper does not analyze or mention any aspects of religion or faith. Its findings are related to evaluation methodologies for information retrieval and recommender systems.
